title: The Wind Chime Assembly
youtube_title: The Wind Chime Assembly | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two careful pairs of hands can do what one rush cannot.
summary: At a harbor dock where baskets are passed up, a wind chime whose strings needed one person to hold and one to knot will go wrong if one person rushes. Farah and Juno split it into two slow jobs, while Uncle Idris only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
